propositions: Repository exhibits unusual maturity with 7.5/10 code, 8.0/10 architecture, 8.0/10 documentation, and 8.0/10 test quality (revised from 8.5 due to CI flakiness).

87 source modules exceed 500-LOC target with orchestration functions showing high cyclomatic complexity (206 functions exceed complexity 15); existing shrink-only ratchet prevents regression but debt remains.
Broad mypy passes production but diagnostic --disallow-untyped-defs found 687 errors; only rebar.graph.* and rebar.grounding.* enforce strictness, requiring package-by-package expansion.
Assignee examples in README and user-guide teach bare handle usage contradicting documented reconciler behavior requiring email/accountId.

Python 3.11 xdist worker flakily dies in test_matching_guard_is_accepted after ~11.4k tests with 'node down: Not properly terminated' across multiple CI runs (Verified 31266912051, 31267701635, 31268737675, 31269084668).

Test coverage at 83.86% combined (85.77% statements, 78.19% branches) with 11,480 passed, strong fixture isolation, no literal assert True tests, and 1,249 test files; external-integration live-executed against Jira, Anthropic, Bedrock, OpenAI, Langfuse.
